name: Ishkashim
confidence_why: 2 independent first-hand descriptions agree (1 state the same rule, 0 refine it); none contradicts.
catalog_quote: The stress generally falls on the final syllable of a polysyllabic word, but there are several exceptions. Some words are accented on the first syllable, for example, rémuzd "sun," ári "work," ṹṧkəz "key," úžˊdən "millet," úrvəs "barley." Some disyllabic and trisyllabic verbs permit free placement of stress, in accordance with the rhythm of the phrase.

audit.reasoning: (1) Quote check: the deciding Iranica quotation is verbatim in the held the Internet Archive text file at the stated Phonetics section. (2) The classification (fixed final, 'fixed-strict' with in the dominant set) rested on a 1998 encyclopaedia summary rather than a primary description; Grierson 1920 (held) gives no rule. sources.quote: «2.1.2. Большая часть слов имеет ударение на последнем слоге: xoman 'мальчик, юноша, парень', ixo 'сестра', ... 'вчера', ... 'верхний' и др. Небольшое количество слов имеет ударение на первом слоге: rémuzd 'солнце', ári 'работа; дело', γúndъm 'пшеница', ... 'невестка', ... 'зола', ... 'отверстие в крыше дома' и др. Фонологической длительности гласных в И.я. нет.» [Most words are stressed on the last syllable; a small number of words are stressed on the first syllable (sun, work, wheat, daughter-in-law, ash, roof-opening, etc.); there is no phonological vowel length.]
sources.note: Primary-author (Pakhalina) statement of the stress rule, §2.1.2 p.198; should replace or back the encyclopaedia quotation as the deciding citation. downloaded now; confirms final stress with a small lexical class of initial-stressed nouns.

sources.quote: No synchronic word-stress placement rule found for Sanglechi-Ishkashmi in the Phonetic System section (stress is marked in transcriptions; p. 297 notes 'secondary lengthening of stressed short vowels and abbreviation of unstressed long ones'); §94 'Accent' (p. 333) treats only the historical (late Old Iranian) accent underlying vowel developments. Based mostly on Sanglechi material.
